title: Two-Input AND Gate
requirement: Generate a block that outputs TRUE only when both inputs are TRUE. * **I/O Variables**: * Inputs: `IN1` (BOOL), `IN2` (BOOL) * Output: `OUT` (BOOL)

title: On-Delay Timer (TON)
requirement: Implement an on-delay timer that sets the output TRUE after a specified duration. * **I/O Variables**: * Inputs: `IN` (BOOL), `PT` (TIME) * Outputs: `Q` (BOOL), `ET` (TIME)

title: SR Flip-Flop
requirement: Set-dominant latch logic. * **I/O Variables**: * Inputs: `S1` (BOOL), `R` (BOOL) * Output: `Q1` (BOOL)

title: Up-Counter (CTU)
requirement: Count rising edges of an input signal. * **I/O Variables**: * Inputs: `CU` (BOOL), `RESET` (BOOL), `PV` (INT) * Outputs: `Q` (BOOL), `CV` (INT)

tests.name: CTU count to PV=3 with reset

title: Off-Delay Timer (TOF)
requirement: Implement an off-delay timer: output stays TRUE while IN is TRUE and remains TRUE for PT duration after IN falls FALSE.

title: Temperature Unit Converter
requirement: Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit. * **I/O Variables**: * Input: `TempC` (REAL) * Output: `TempF` (REAL)

title: Blink Generator
requirement: Toggle a bit at a 1Hz frequency (500ms ON, 500ms OFF). * **I/O Variables**: * Input: `ENABLE` (BOOL) * Output: `OUT` (BOOL)

title: Greater Than Comparison
requirement: Compare two integers and set output if the first is greater. * **I/O Variables**: * Inputs: `VAL1` (INT), `VAL2` (INT) * Output: `RESULT` (BOOL)

title: Hysteresis Control
requirement: Implement a simple Schmitt trigger logic. * **I/O Variables**: * Inputs: `Val` (REAL), `High` (REAL), `Low` (REAL) * Output: `Q` (BOOL)

title: Absolute Value
requirement: Return the absolute value of a signed integer. * **I/O Variables**: * Input: `InputVal` (INT) * Output: `AbsVal` (INT)

title: Star-Delta Motor Starter
requirement: Sequence a motor start from Star to Delta configuration after 5 seconds. * **I/O Variables**: * Inputs: `START` (BOOL), `STOP` (BOOL) * Outputs: `Main` (BOOL), `Star` (BOOL), `Delta` (BOOL)

title: DOL Motor Starter with Overload Protection
requirement: Direct-On-Line motor starter: latch RUN from START pushbutton, drop out on STOP or thermal OVERLOAD; OVERLOAD latches FAULT until reset by STOP.

title: Analog Clamping
requirement: Ensure an analog value stays within safe bounds (Min/Max). * **I/O Variables**: * Inputs: `IN` (REAL), `MinL` (REAL), `MaxL` (REAL) * Output: `OUT` (REAL)

title: Conveyor Box Sorting
requirement: On a running conveyor, detect boxes at a photo sensor (rising edge of PhotoIn): tall boxes (SizeHigh=TRUE) are diverted (Diverter=TRUE) and counted in CountDivert, short boxes pass (Diverter=FALSE) and increment CountPass. When the conveyor stops, retract the diverter.

title: Lead-Lag Pump Control
requirement: Alternates between two pumps to balance wear. * **I/O Variables**: * Inputs: `Demand` (BOOL), `Swap` (BOOL) * Outputs: `Pump1` (BOOL), `Pump2` (BOOL)

title: Two-Way Traffic Light
requirement: Sequence: Green (10s), Yellow (3s), Red (13s). * **I/O Variables**: * Output: `G` (BOOL), `Y` (BOOL), `R` (BOOL)

title: Signal Debounce
requirement: Filter out noise on a digital input; signal must be stable for 50ms. * **I/O Variables**: * Input: `RawIn` (BOOL) * Output: `FilteredOut` (BOOL)

title: Bottle Filling Station
requirement: Semi-automatic bottle filler with 4 states: Idle (all off), Feeding (conveyor runs until BottleDetected), Filling (conveyor stops, fill valve opens until FullSignal), Discharge (conveyor runs until the bottle leaves the sensor, then back to Idle).

title: Moving Average (3 Samples)
requirement: Provide the average of the last three inputs. * **I/O Variables**: * Input: `NewVal` (REAL) * Output: `Avg` (REAL)

title: Ramp Function
requirement: Gradually increase/decrease output toward a setpoint. * **I/O Variables**: * Inputs: `Setpoint` (REAL), `Rate` (REAL) * Output: `Out` (REAL)

tests.name: ramp up to setpoint with clamp

title: Batch Mixing State Machine
requirement: Manage states: Idle, Filling, Mixing, Emptying. * **I/O Variables**: * Inputs: `Start` (BOOL), `LevelFull` (BOOL), `LevelEmpty` (BOOL) * Outputs: `FillValve` (BOOL), `Motor` (BOOL), `DrainValve` (BOOL)

title: Simple PID Controller
requirement: Implement basic Proportional-Integral-Derivative control logic. * **I/O Variables**: * Inputs: `PV` (REAL), `SP` (REAL), `Kp` (REAL), `Ki` (REAL), `Kd` (REAL) * Output: `Out` (REAL)

tests.name: zero error gives zero output (P only)

title: Array Maximum Finder
requirement: Iterate through an array of 10 integers to find the highest value. * **I/O Variables**: * Input: `Vals` (ARRAY[0..9] OF INT) * Output: `MaxVal` (INT)

title: Alarm Latching and Ack
requirement: Latch alarm until condition cleared and Acknowledged. * **I/O Variables**: * Inputs: `Fault` (BOOL), `Ack` (BOOL) * Output: `AlarmActive` (BOOL)

title: Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC-8)
requirement: Calculate a basic XOR-based checksum for 4 bytes. * **I/O Variables**: * Input: `Data` (ARRAY[0..3] OF BYTE) * Output: `CRC` (BYTE)

title: Linear Interpolation (XY Lookup)
requirement: Calculate Y for a given X based on two points (X1,Y1) and (X2,Y2). * **I/O Variables**: * Inputs: `X`, `X1`, `Y1`, `X2`, `Y2` (REAL) * Output: `Y` (REAL)

tests.name: degenerate segment falls back to Y1

title: Bubble Sort (Small Array)
requirement: Sort 5 integers in ascending order. * **I/O Variables**: * In_Out: `Arr` (ARRAY[0..4] OF INT)

title: Frequency Measurement
requirement: Calculate frequency (Hz) based on pulses per second. * **I/O Variables**: * Input: `Pulse` (BOOL) * Output: `Freq` (REAL)

title: Modbus Payload Packing
requirement: Pack two 16-bit INTs into a 4-byte array. * **I/O Variables**: * Inputs: `Val1` (INT), `Val2` (INT) * Output: `Payload` (ARRAY[0..3] OF BYTE)

title: Elevator Cabin Logic
requirement: Control movement between 3 floors based on calls. * **I/O Variables**: * Inputs: `CallFloor` (INT), `AtFloor` (INT) * Outputs: `MotorUp` (BOOL), `MotorDown` (BOOL)
